events.title: MTV Launched 45 Years Ago
events.blurb: On August 1st, 1981, MTV burst onto screens, forever changing the music landscape, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' famously being its first broadcast.

angles.name: Music TV Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed everything? Forty-five years ago, MTV launched and gave us a whole new way to experience our favourite artists. What was the first music video you ever saw that blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis's Debut Album Turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis's seminal debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', was released on August 29th, 1994, kicking off a Britpop phenomenon.

angles.name: Britpop Kicks Off
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your go-to track from that iconic debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment of the 1960s counterculture, took place from August 15th to 18th, 1969, on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. Which legendary performance would you have loved to witness?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Today marks the 49th anniversary of the passing of 'The King of Rock & Roll', Elvis Presley, who died on August 16th, 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years on, the incomparable legacy of Elvis Presley lives large. His music, his style, his impact – truly one of a kind.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On September 7th, 1996, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries six days later on September 13th.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. His voice and lyrics continue to resonate, decades after his untimely passing.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18th, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true trailblazer. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released in the UK on September 26th, 1969, becoming their last recorded album.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, let alone the music within.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: American-British singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, best known as the frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking, still iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a formidable solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or loathe him, you can't deny his rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11th, 1971, encouraging listeners to envision a world of peace.

angles.name: Imagine 55 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23rd, 2001, forever changing how we listen to music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed our lives. Remember clicking through that scroll wheel to find your tunes? What was on your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007, the spy who's always got a licence to thrill. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, born on October 9th, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22nd, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical range.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A truly monumental release.
